737:t_136:6.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I won't obey. Not even if you're emissaries of God.」

737:t_137:0.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「$$始原の特異点$$. It was the guidance of the $$黒い太陽#sol$$ that brought you this far.」

737:t_137:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「But too bad! If we wipe you guys out, the universe's great collapse will stop, so we don't need any $$特異点$$!」

737:t_137:3.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Your worth lies in becoming the key to true $$時空修復|lc$$... That, and nothing more.」

737:t_137:4.en:
$$桂$$
「Treating people as less than human is one thing, but when it goes this far, I don't know whether to get angry or just be appalled...」

737:t_137:5.en:
$$モーム$$
「Guys like you could never understand $$桂$$'s good points or his wonderful sides! $$桂$$ is... $$桂$$ is...!」

737:t_137:6.en:
$$桂$$
「Thanks, $$モーム$$. Having someone close by who understands is enough for me.」

737:t_137:7.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「But, $$始原の特異点$$, you must atone for the sin of giving birth to the multiverse.」

737:t_137:8.en:
$$桂$$
「You don't have to tell me! That's why I came all this way!」

737:t_137:9.en:
$$桂$$
「For starters, I'm smashing that old man and that little girl who think they rule the universe! That comes first!!」

737:t_138:0.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「With all eight $$スフィア$$s lost along with $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, we must make sure the $$スフィア$$s that remain stay in our hands.」

737:t_138:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「$$悲しみの乙女$$! If you want, I'll even make you an executive of the new $$サイデリアル$$!」

737:t_138:3.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Angry? Oh, right... In your case, it's sadness, isn't it!」

737:t_138:4.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「That is exactly what makes a $$スフィア$$ shine! $$ハマリエル・ザ・スター$$! Come to us!」

737:t_138:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I am $$セツコ・オハラ$$! A proud member of $$グローリー・スター$$, and one of the members of $c!」

737:t_138:6.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I will fight, overcoming the sorrow you have brought into being!」

737:t_138:7.en:
$$セツコ$$
「To keep any more needless sorrow from spreading through this universe!!」

737:t_139:0.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「So you've come, $$ウェルキエル・ザ・ヒート$$.」

737:t_139:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You're a bit hot and stuffy, but you look like you'll make a good toy to replace $$エルーナルーナ$$.」

737:t_139:2.en:
$$メール$$
「Darling doesn't belong to you guys! He's mine!」

737:t_139:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「You've got no right to say a thing about $$メール$$! And that goes for me and the $$ガンレオン$$, too!」

737:t_139:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「I've never met anyone who pissed me off this much! Against these guys, there's no need for me and the $$ガンレオン$$ to hold back!」

737:t_139:7.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「$$傷だらけの獅子$$! Do you mean to abandon your own role!?」

737:t_139:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「My job is repairman, and I'm a member of $c!」

737:t_139:9.en:
$$ランド$$
「Here I come, $$御使い$$! My role is to beat down scum like you and knock some sense into that twisted attitude of yours!!」

737:t_140:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I was fighting to pay off my debt, and I never figured I'd run into a villain this outrageous.」

737:t_140:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You're so petty! Talking about money at a time like this!」

737:t_140:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Say what you like. That's how people live, each with their own dreams and goals.」

737:t_140:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Anyone who messes with that for their own selfish convenience gets a punch from me, or I won't be satisfied!」

737:t_140:4.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「I will acknowledge that strong will of yours, $$ズリエル・ジ・アンブレイカブル$$.」

737:t_140:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「'I will acknowledge'...? Give me a break! You still don't get your position, do you!」

737:t_140:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Quit acting like the rulers forever! The moment we got in close, you guys had already lost!」

737:t_140:8.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Get ready, $$御使い$$! Once I've knocked you and that big hunk of junk down, I'm going to smash the main idol you worship, the $$黒い太陽#sol$$!!」

737:t_141:0.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「$n~! You've already achieved your goal, so let's stop fighting.」

737:t_141:1.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Your goal was to overthrow $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. Now that it's done, come to us as a Reactor.」

737:t_141:2.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「From now on, I'll be calling you $$アムブリエル・ジ・オーバーライザー$$, okay?」

737:t_141:4.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Oh... really. Then I don't want you, not one bit.」

737:t_141:5.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Since you have refused our invitation, you will face retribution.」

737:t_141:6.en:
$n
「That's what 120 million years of living gets you. Your heads must be growing mold.」

737:t_141:8.en:
$n
「You're no different from this $$エス・テラン$$. Dead already, for all intents and purposes.」

737:t_141:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n is right! Know that there is no place for you in this universe!」

737:t_141:10.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Fool! You are a Reactor, yet you turn against us!」

737:t_141:11.en:
$n
「I'll show you which of us is the fool, $$御使い$$! You've made yourselves beings the universe doesn't need!」

737:t_141:12.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「$n! You still dare talk like that...!」

737:t_141:13.en:
$n
「Shut up, $$テンプティ$$! I'm not going to let you say another word!」

737:t_141:14.en:
$n
「It's over, $$御使い$$! We'll take you down and save the universe!!」
